# User rules (Claude Code / Codex)

**Generated; do not edit.** Edit `rules/manifest.json`, `BASE.md` with `BASE.mdc`, or the `.mdc` / `agents.d/` body a section names, then run `bin/generate-agents-md.py --apply`. Never symlink `rules/` to `~/.claude/rules` (double load).

Not mirrored: glob-scoped `enonic-*.mdc` (they belong in Enonic repos' `CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.md`) and Cursor-only `memory-filesystem.mdc`. `graphify.mdc` is opt-in: do not auto-run graphify or rebuild `graphify-out/`; on `/graphify` or `@graphify`, follow `skills/graphify/SKILL.md`.
